opt.title: Settings
opt.cookiesHint: When enabled, your YouTube cookies are sent only to your own server and only to unlock these videos.
home.featQualityDesc: Source-faithful quality — no fake 320k. You get exactly what's there.
home.featMediaDesc: Music, a clip or a whole gallery — all from a single link.
home.featFreeDesc: No sign-up, no ads, no limits — download right away.
home.featApiDesc: Plug it into your own app. Read the docs.
docs.title: API documentation
docs.intro: With the Siphon API you can build media downloading from any site straight into your own app. Simple JSON requests, clear responses.
docs.baseUrlDesc: All requests go to this address.
docs.authDesc: To get a token, register — a key is created in your dashboard (/dashboard). Add it to the header of every request.
docs.probeDesc: Inspects a link and returns the available audio, video and image variants.
docs.jobsDesc: Starts a download job and returns its id.
docs.jobsParamOutput: Result type: audio, video or gallery.
docs.jobsParamFormat: Format: for audio — mp3, m4a or opus; for video — mp4 or webm.
docs.jobsParamFormatId: Optional — the exact format id returned by probe.
docs.jobStatusDesc: Returns the job state, and the file link once it's ready.
docs.filesDesc: Serves the finished file by token (binary).
docs.filesParamToken: One-time token to access the file.
docs.errQuota: Daily limit reached — wait a bit or upgrade your plan.
docs.quotaNote: When you go over the limit, the API returns 429 with the quota-exceeded code. Try again a little later.
docs.scalarDesc: A full, try-it-out reference (Scalar) is available at /reference on the API server host.
bot.title: Download via the Telegram bot
bot.subtitle: No app, no sign-up — send the bot a link and get your file.
bot.step1Desc: Open the bot in Telegram with the button above.
bot.step2Desc: Start the bot and pick your language.
bot.step3Desc: Send any media link — YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and more.
bot.step5Desc: For audio — MP3, M4A or OPUS; for video — MP4 or WEBM.
bot.step7Desc: The bot prepares it and sends the file right into the chat.
bot.noteLimit: Telegram's file limit is 50 MB. For larger files use the website or the API.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to get a token and manage your downloads.
auth.registerSubtitle: Register in a minute — it's free.
auth.telegramOff: Telegram sign-in isn't set up yet.
auth.providerNote: Google and GitHub work only if configured on the server.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to your email. Enter it below.
auth.error: Couldn't sign in. Check your details and try again.

dash.tokensDesc: Create a token to access the API and add it to your request header.
dash.tokenOnce: This key is shown only once. Copy and store it safely — it won't be shown again.
dash.usageNote: Per-day usage history isn't shown here yet.
dash.docsLink: How to use your token — docs
